title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez excel in Patriots training camp, earning praise from teammates and coaches.
Newcomer Dre'Mont Jones impresses with his physicality, emerging as a key player in New England's defense.
Kyle Williams struggles to stand out at camp, logging reps with third-team offense amid crowded receiver room.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias, Boston's No. 2 baseball prospect, is excelling in Triple-A, batting .326 with 12 RBI in 10 games.
Red Sox evaluate Arias for potential MLB call-up amid injuries to Trevor Story and Isiah Kiner-Falefa.
Red Sox official Craig Breslow emphasizes Arias needs further development despite impressive Triple-A performance.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police seek public help to identify a suspect in a breaking and entering case in Jamaica Plain.
The suspect reportedly climbed through a bedroom window and attempted to pull a blanket off a sleeping victim.
The suspect is described as a Black male, late teens to early 20s, slim build, wearing a white t-shirt and cap.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: A 2023 Ford Maverick owner experienced premature sway bar link failure at 22,000 miles, suggesting possible quality issues.
Torx-Plus fasteners, replacing Torx, offer a more precise fit and durability, potentially useful in automated assembly.
The Car Doctor recommended CTEK and Deltran Battery Tender for maintaining infrequently used car batteries, citing reliability.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown expressed mixed emotions about his trade from the Celtics to the 76ers during his introduction in Philadelphia.
Brown and his former teammate Jayson Tatum have not communicated since the trade, highlighting a non-personal off-court relationship.
High expectations await Brown in Philadelphia as he joins stars like LeBron James and Joel Embiid in pursuit of a title.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults injured in a bus rollover in Mattapan; no children were on board, police report.
The crash occurred near 1000 Harvard St., authorities responded shortly before 1:10 p.m. on Thursday.
The cause of the school bus rollover remains unknown; victims were hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye threw two interceptions during a two-minute drill at Patriots training camp in Foxborough.
Marcus Bryant took first-team reps at left tackle, replacing injured Will Campbell who wore an arm brace.
Gabe Jacas and other players received first-team reps, indicating progress toward the preseason opener against Indianapolis.

title: A beloved Cape Cod restaurant is closing after 21 years
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Chach Restaurant in Provincetown, Cape Cod, will close on November 2 after 21 years of operation.
Owners Viola "Chach" Briseño and Sharon Bowes cited the demanding nature of the business as a reason for closure.
Chach Restaurant, known for its scratch-made dishes, employs six staff but handles all cooking personally by the owners.

title: The best movies on Netflix right now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless' (1995) is now streaming on Netflix, featuring Alicia Silverstone in a modern take on Jane Austen's 'Emma'.
'Eighth Grade' (2018), directed by Bo Burnham, portrays middle school anxiety through the eyes of a 13-year-old girl.
Martin Scorsese's 'The Irishman' (2019) is a 210-minute crime saga starring Robert De Niro and Al Pacino.

title: Navy says it can’t help recover wreckage of Gloucester fishing boat Lily Jean
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: The US Navy declined to assist in recovering the fishing boat Lily Jean off Cape Ann, which sank in January 2026.
Governor Maura Healey sought Navy help for the wreckage investigation, but the Navy cited other agencies' ongoing reviews.
State officials vow to continue pursuing information about the sinking to aid families of the seven lost crew members.
